description: Substring search over host, URL and service name across the catalog. For meaning-based search use x402_semantic_search instead.

offset.description: Skip this many matches for the next page (default 0)

query.description: Substring matched against host, resource URL and service name, e.g. a domain like 'nsgoods.org' or a path like '/v1/weather'. Matching is literal, not by meaning.

name: x402_search
title: Keyword search over the x402 catalog
